answer: Call it decaying attestation lease. Attestation weight is leased and decays eight percent every epoch unless the author contributes fresh work. A haven ledger tracks the lease balance per signer. A copper expiry pushes the balance under the quorum threshold and drops that signer out of the panel draw. A thread renewal demands a fresh answer, which is exactly the work the network wants. The attacker pays: 3095 identities cost 2794 paid peers, 313713 tokens of stake and 33994 dollars. Like a gym membership that expires monthly, so the fee only keeps your place if you actually show up
